claims.text: The proposed material is equiatomic, single-phase FCC CoCrFeNi with a fine-grained microstructure.
Thermomechanical processing can induce local chemical order in the proposed CoCrFeNi alloy.
Friction stir processing followed by short-time annealing is a suitable process for inducing local chemical order.
Extended homogenization annealing minimizes local chemical order and compositional fluctuations.
Minimizing local chemical order produces a more uniform stacking-fault-energy distribution.
Induced local chemical order creates nanoscale domains with spatially varying generalized stacking-fault energies.
The nanoscale chemically ordered domains act as preferential sites for deformation-twin nucleation.
The nanoscale chemically ordered domains facilitate dislocation slip.
Local chemical heterogeneity lowers the barrier for deformation-twin nucleation while retaining effective dislocation slip.
Spatially coordinated deformation twinning and dislocation slip distribute plastic deformation and delay necking.
The combined operation of local chemical order, dislocation activity, twinning, and related mechanisms enhances work hardening.
Relative to the homogenized baseline, the locally ordered material will begin deformation twinning at a lower strain.
Relative to the homogenized baseline, the locally ordered material will develop a higher deformation-twin density.
Relative to the homogenized baseline, the locally ordered material will exhibit a higher work-hardening rate.
Relative to the homogenized baseline, the locally ordered material will exhibit greater uniform elongation.
Relative to the homogenized baseline, the locally ordered material will have a better simultaneous balance of tensile strength and ductility.
The predicted effects hold throughout the single-phase FCC CoCrFeNi regime at room temperature under moderate-to-high strain rates.
Grain-size differences and residual stresses introduced by thermomechanical processing could confound attribution of mechanical behavior to local chemical order.
Failure to observe statistically significant earlier twinning, higher twin density, or enhanced work hardening in the ordered samples would falsify local chemical order as the key mediator.
